title: Explorium
description: A mostly client side modpack designed to make Minecraft look and play better than ever before!
body:
Welcome to Explorium! I've put together this modpack to transform your Minecraft experience into something truly amazing. Whether you're an adventurer seeking new horizons or a creator perfecting your builds, Explorium is packed with mods to elevate your gameplay.

**Top-Notch Performance**: Mods like Lithium, FerriteCore, and Krypton ensure smooth gameplay—even in massive worlds or multiplayer sessions.

**Immersive Visuals**: With Iris Shaders, LambDynamicLights, and Presence Footsteps, your world will look and feel more alive than ever.

**Easy Customization**: Tools like Mod Menu, Reese's Sodium Options, and YACL give you full control over your settings to make the game yours.

**Streamlined Gameplay**: Enjoy quality-of-life mods like Pick Up Notifier, Mouse Tweaks, and Zoomify that just make everything better.

**Exploration and Creativity**: Mods like Bobby and Distant Horizons let you push boundaries and build without limits.

**Dynamic Experiences**: With mods like Sound Physics Remastered and Particle Rain, every step of your journey feels unique.

If there are any glitches please report them on the official Discord server.

If your computer is lagging try updating the modpack or disabling the Distant Horizans mod.
